**Last updated: October 28, 2026**

## 1. General

1. ## 6. Registration and Passwords

1. If the Website offers customer accounts, you must provide accurate information when registering and keep your account details up to date.

2. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and account credentials and for activity carried out through your account, subject to applicable law.

3. You should notify us promptly at **recordsvunion@gmail.com** if you become aware of unauthorised access to your account or a security concern relating to it.

4. You must not access another person's account without permission.

5. We may restrict or suspend account access where reasonably necessary for security, suspected misuse, breach of these Terms, or compliance with applicable law.

6. You are responsible for having a compatible device, internet connection, and browser capable of accessing the Website. Some features may depend on JavaScript, cookies, or third-party services.

7. Information about how we collect and use personal information and cookies is explained in our Privacy Policy.

## 7. Products

1. VN SHOP may offer products such as clothing, accessories, posters, physical music products, digital music, gift cards, and other merchandise or creative products. The products actually available are those displayed on the Website.

2. Product availability, sizes, colours, variants, and specifications are limited to the options shown on the relevant product page.

3. Product images are provided to illustrate the products. Reasonable differences in colour or appearance may occur due to display settings, production variations, or other circumstances.

4. Where a product is offered as a limited edition, preorder, or made-to-order item, any special conditions and estimated fulfilment information displayed on the product page will apply, subject to applicable law.

5. We may add, remove, modify, or discontinue products and product options. Changes will not override rights already granted to customers under applicable law.

6. Digital products, where offered, are subject to the access and usage conditions stated on the relevant product page and at checkout.

## 8. Placing an Order

1. By placing an order, you confirm that you are legally capable of entering into a binding contract under the laws applicable to you. If you are not legally able to enter into such a contract independently, the required parent, guardian, or legal representative must act as required by applicable law.

2. Follow the instructions displayed on the Website to select products, review your order, provide the required information, and complete checkout.

3. Products selected for purchase may be placed in a shopping cart or equivalent checkout area. You can review and, where available, amend your selection before submitting your order.

4. Before completing checkout, you should check your product selection, quantities, delivery details, payment method, and the total amount payable.

5. When placing an order, you must provide accurate and complete information necessary to process the purchase and deliver the products.

6. An order confirmation indicates that your order has been received. It does not necessarily mean that the order has been accepted or dispatched.

7. We may need to review, reject, or cancel an order where there is a genuine issue involving availability, pricing, payment authorisation, inaccurate information, suspected fraud, a technical error, or another legitimate reason. Where payment has been taken for an order that is cancelled, the applicable refund will be processed in accordance with our Refund Policy and applicable law.

8. Once an order has entered processing or has been dispatched, changes to the products, quantities, or delivery address may not be possible. Contact us promptly if you identify an error. Any cancellation or change remains subject to the applicable policy and your statutory rights.

9. Order preparation generally takes **2–7 business days**. Delivery after dispatch may take approximately **2 days to 4 weeks**, depending on the destination, carrier, customs procedures, and other circumstances. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates. Any mandatory statutory delivery deadlines remain applicable.

10. Where tracking is available, tracking information may be provided after dispatch.

11. You are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address. Incorrect or incomplete address details may cause delays, failed delivery, or additional shipping arrangements.

12. If a shipment is returned, delayed, or cannot be delivered, we may contact you using the details provided with your order to determine the appropriate next steps, subject to applicable law.

13. If an order contains multiple products, availability or fulfilment requirements may affect whether the products are dispatched together or separately. Any applicable shipping charges and arrangements will be communicated through the Website or checkout where relevant.

## 9. General Disclaimers and Promotions

1. Product prices, discounts, promotional offers, and stock availability are displayed on the Website. Unless otherwise stated, the price and terms shown at checkout apply to the order.

2. We may correct obvious listing or pricing errors and may cancel an affected order where permitted by applicable law. If payment has already been taken for an order that cannot be fulfilled, the applicable refund will be processed.

3. Promotions are subject to the conditions displayed with the relevant offer, including any eligibility requirements, duration, stock limitations, or restrictions on combining offers.

4. We may modify or withdraw a promotion where permitted by applicable law. Changes will not remove rights that have already accrued to a customer under applicable law.

5. Nothing in these Terms excludes any mandatory consumer protection or other legal right that cannot lawfully be excluded.

## 10. Payment

1. Available payment methods are those presented at checkout. Payment processing may be provided by third-party payment providers.

2. By submitting a payment, you confirm that you are authorised to use the selected payment method.

3. Product prices and any applicable shipping charges, taxes, or other fees will be presented at checkout as required by applicable law.

4. We may correct pricing errors before fulfilling an order where permitted by law. If a material error affects your order, we may contact you to resolve it or cancel the affected order and arrange any required refund.

5. Payment authorisation, collection, settlement, and refunds may be handled by the relevant payment provider according to its procedures.

6. Payment providers may process payment information under their own privacy policies and security practices. We do not intend to collect or store full payment card security details directly where these are handled by the payment provider.

7. We may take reasonable steps to detect and prevent fraudulent or unauthorised transactions. An order may be delayed, reviewed, or cancelled if there are reasonable grounds to suspect fraud or a payment problem, subject to applicable law.

## 11. Cancellation, Delivery, and Usage Rules

## 11.1. Digital Products

**i. Cancellation and Withdrawal**

Digital downloads and other digital content are subject to the conditions stated on the relevant product page and at checkout, as well as applicable law.

Where permitted by applicable law, digital content that has been supplied or made available for immediate access may be non-refundable once delivery or access has begun, provided that any legally required express consent, acknowledgement, and prior information concerning the loss of the right of withdrawal have been obtained.

Nothing in these Terms removes a mandatory right to cancel, withdraw, or obtain a refund where such a right applies.

**ii. Delivery and Access**

Digital products, where available, will be delivered or made accessible using the method described on the relevant product page or during checkout. Access may depend on successful payment, account access, technical compatibility, or instructions provided by the Website.

**iii. Usage Rules**

Unless a separate written licence states otherwise, digital products are licensed for personal, non-commercial use only. Purchasing or downloading a digital product does not transfer copyright or other intellectual property rights.

You may not redistribute, resell, publicly share, commercially exploit, or create unauthorised derivative works from digital products.

**iv. Technical Problems and Defective Digital Products**

If a digital product is inaccessible, defective, or materially different from its description, contact us at **recordsvunion@gmail.com**. We will review the issue and provide an appropriate remedy in accordance with the applicable policy and law.

## 11.2. Physical Products

**i. Cancellation and Returns**

For orders delivered within Türkiye, consumers may exercise the applicable statutory right of withdrawal within **14 days of receiving the product**, subject to the conditions and exceptions established by applicable law. A withdrawal notice may be sent to **recordsvunion@gmail.com** within the applicable period.

Products should be returned in accordance with the instructions provided by us and the requirements of applicable law. Where relevant, products should be returned with their original packaging, tags, and included accessories, and should not have been worn, washed, or altered beyond what is legally permitted for inspection.

Any exceptions for customised or personalised products, opened sealed products, digital content, or other legally excluded categories apply only to the extent recognised by applicable law. A product's limited-edition, discounted, clearance, or sale status does not by itself remove a mandatory consumer right.

For international orders, VN SHOP offers a voluntary return period of **30 days from delivery**, where permitted by law and subject to the applicable Refund Policy. This voluntary return period does not replace or restrict any longer or otherwise mandatory rights available to the customer.

Return shipping costs and arrangements are governed by the Refund Policy and applicable law. Customers will not be charged return costs where applicable law prohibits those charges.

**ii. Delivery**

We aim to prepare orders within approximately **2–7 business days**. Delivery after dispatch may take approximately **2 days to 4 weeks**. Actual delivery times depend on the shipping destination, carrier, customs procedures, and other circumstances.

These estimates do not override mandatory statutory delivery deadlines or remedies available when an order is not delivered as required by law.

**iii. Risk and Ownership**

Ownership of a purchased product transfers in accordance with applicable law and the terms governing the transaction. Nothing in these Terms removes any mandatory rights you may have concerning loss, damage, delivery, or ownership.

## 12. Damaged, Incorrect, or Incomplete Orders

1. If an order arrives damaged, incorrect, or incomplete, contact **recordsvunion@gmail.com** and include your order number and a description of the issue.

2. Where reasonably possible, provide photographs or other information that helps us assess the issue. We may request additional details where necessary.

3. We will review the claim and arrange an appropriate solution, which may include a replacement, repair, return, or refund, depending on the circumstances, the applicable policy, and applicable law.

4. Please retain the affected product and its packaging until we provide instructions, where reasonably possible.

5. Nothing in this section limits mandatory consumer rights relating to defective, damaged, incorrect, or incomplete products.

## 13. Refund Policy

1. Refund eligibility and procedures are explained in our Refund Policy, which forms part of the policies governing purchases through VN SHOP. In the event of any inconsistency, mandatory applicable law prevails.

2. For orders delivered within Türkiye, eligible consumers may exercise the statutory right of withdrawal within 14 days of receiving the product, subject to applicable legal conditions and exceptions.

3. For international orders, VN SHOP offers a voluntary 30-day return period from delivery where permitted by law. This voluntary policy does not limit any mandatory statutory rights.

4. Digital downloads and digital content may be non-refundable after delivery or access begins only where permitted by law and where any required consent and acknowledgement conditions have been satisfied. Mandatory remedies for defective or incorrectly supplied digital content remain unaffected.

5. If an order is cancelled by us after payment has been received, or a refund is otherwise due, we will process the applicable refund within the period required by law and the relevant Refund Policy.

6. Where required, refunds will include the applicable delivery charges and will be made using the original payment method, without imposing unlawful fees or burdens on the customer. The time required for the refund to appear may depend on the payment provider or financial institution.

7. Return shipping costs will be allocated in accordance with the Refund Policy and applicable law. No provision of these Terms requires a customer to bear return costs where such a requirement is prohibited by law.

8. If a product is defective, damaged, incorrect, or incomplete, we will review the issue and provide the remedy required by applicable law and our published policies.

9. Nothing in these Terms removes or restricts a refund, withdrawal, cancellation, or other remedy that is mandatory under applicable law.

## 14. Technical Problems

1. We aim to keep the Website and its services available and functioning properly, but uninterrupted access cannot be guaranteed.

2. Technical issues may affect ordering, payment, account access, digital product delivery, or other Website functions.

3. We will take reasonable steps to address technical problems that come to our attention.

4. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for failures or delays caused by inaccurate information supplied by a customer, incompatible devices or software, misuse of the Website, third-party service interruptions, or events beyond our reasonable control.

5. This section does not limit any rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

## 15. International Orders and Import Duties

1. Delivery availability and estimated delivery times depend on the destination and the shipping options offered at checkout.

2. International shipments may be subject to customs procedures, import duties, taxes, or other charges imposed by the destination country. Responsibility for such charges will be determined by the shipping terms, checkout disclosures, and applicable law.

3. Customers are responsible for complying with applicable laws and import requirements in the destination country.

4. We cannot guarantee that customs authorities or shipping carriers will process every shipment within a particular timeframe.

5. If delivery to a particular destination is unavailable or restricted, the relevant limitations may be stated on the Website or during checkout.

## 16. Games and Interactive Features

2. Unless expressly stated otherwise, the text, graphics, logos, images, audio, downloads, software, and other materials associated with such features remain the property of their respective rights holders.

## 17. Ticket and Event Presale Terms

4. Any restrictions on resale, transfer, cancellation, or refunds will be communicated with the relevant offer and will apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law.

## 18. Termination and Suspension

2. Where appropriate and permitted by law, we may provide notice or an opportunity to resolve the issue before restricting access.

3. Suspension or termination of access does not remove rights or obligations arising from orders already placed, payments already made, or applicable consumer protection law.

4. Any intellectual property permissions granted under these Terms end when the relevant permission expires or is lawfully terminated, except where otherwise agreed in writing or required by law.

2. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits any warranty, consumer right, or legal responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

3. We may use service providers and contractors to support Website operations, order processing, payment handling, shipping, and other services.

We are not responsible for a delay or failure to perform an obligation to the extent it results from an event beyond our reasonable control, such as natural disasters, severe weather, public emergencies, transport disruptions, customs delays, widespread technical outages, or interruptions affecting third-party providers.

2. Where such an event affects an order or service, we will take reasonable steps to limit the impact and fulfil our obligations when reasonably possible.

3. This section does not remove any refund, cancellation, or other right that applies under mandatory law.

## 22. Resolving Disputes

2. We will review the matter and attempt to resolve it through communication where reasonably possible.

## 23. Miscellaneous

8. Customers must comply with applicable laws when accessing the Website, purchasing products, or importing products into their country.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: VN SHOP respects your privacy. This notice explains the main types of information that may be processed when you use the website.

sections.heading: Information you provide
sections.text: If you use account sign-in, your email address is processed to send a verification code and establish your account session. If you choose to receive updates from 9ojeez9, that preference may also be associated with the account sign-up request.

sections.heading: Authentication
sections.text: Account authentication is provided by Supabase. Your email address, verification requests, and authentication session are processed as needed to provide sign-in functionality. Never share a verification code with anyone.

sections.heading: Cookies and preferences
sections.text: The website stores your cookie preferences in your browser so that your selections can be remembered. You can review those choices using Cookie Choices in the website footer.

sections.heading: How information is used
sections.text: Information may be used to operate account features, maintain website security, remember your preferences, and provide features you request.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.text: The website relies on third-party services for functionality such as authentication and loading external resources. Those services may process technical data under their own terms and privacy notices.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.text: You can choose whether to request account sign-in and whether to opt in to updates. You can also adjust your cookie preferences using Cookie Choices.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.text: For privacy questions, visit Help & Support. The full published policy is also available at Privacy Policy.
